refactoring_opportunities_evaluated.reason: Trade-off: Additional abstraction would add complexity without significant benefit. Functions serve different purposes (production vs testing) with different debug outputs and test data.
Port variables are not needed in .env.docker because Docker containers use internal port 8000. External ports are configured via docker-compose.*.yml files which read from .env or .env.local.
Comments are already well-organized and provide clear documentation for each section.
